capabilities.name: Terminology Admission Orchestration Gate
capabilities.responsibility: Resolve governed product-scoped terminology before reasoning-plan construction and publish either a bounded canonical terminology context or an explicit blocked handoff.
capabilities.authority_role: Pre-planning terminology admission authority only. It may expose governed canonical terminology and implementation context after deterministic contextual resolution; it cannot create facts, infer unresolved applicability, execute reasoning, generate explanations, compare, rank, assess suitability, or recommend.
safety_invariants: Unresolved terminology must produce BLOCKED and may not silently advance to reasoning or explanation.
READY handoffs must contain the required governed canonical concept and product implementation identifiers.
The gate may expose only deterministic governed terminology context and must preserve ambiguity or missing-context failures.
Star Comprehensive wiring supplies a governed resolver configuration only and does not broaden the gate's authority.
capabilities.notes: Census registration of the existing fail-closed terminology pre-reasoning gate and its Star Comprehensive resolver wiring.
